title: A master equation for Carter-separable stationary axisymmetric spacetimes and compatible sources
summary: We show that the remaining diagonal Einstein equations in the Carter-projective sector of stationary axisymmetric spacetimes are equivalent to a single sourced master equation. The projective structure is taken as the input fixed by the off-diagonal Einstein equations. In the anti-aligned exponential branch, which contains the Kerr--Carter and Plebański--Demiański real section, the remaining diagonal Einstein system reduces to \[ \mathcal L_{\rm CP}[Δ,Y] =16πΣ\left( T_{\hat0\hat0}+T_{\hat3\hat3} \right), \] where \(Δ(r)\) and \(Y(x)\) are the radial and angular structure functions.
